technical-summary: RHP16 step 5: helper measurement hooks complete the calibration record; heat-shifting calibration workload; every live-policy setting derived from measured quantities in the planner's own units (margin = sampling error, min_samples in heat windows, per-transaction caps, timers matched to evaluation); effect gate per routed row on per-helper service published in the shared segment (v24), relative to peers, window sized from measured noise, derived off where the tail's work has no peer reference; calibration that cannot derive a policy serves without one; bounded, self-diagnosing calibration waits; observation-spaced drift window; calibration key excludes engine_build so records carry across pin bumps. Off by default: active only with a calibration record. Hardware: derived policy cuts filler TTFT 31-35% with prefill and decode level (calib7, calib8).
user-summary-candidate: Flash-Next can now move hot experts between GPUs at runtime with every setting derived from a calibration run; in testing it cut time-to-first-token on a shifting workload by about a third. Off until a layout is calibrated.
